    local i cur prev opts cmd
    COMPREPLY=()
    if [[ "${BASH_VERSINFO[0]}" -ge 4 ]]; then
        cur="$2"
    else
        cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    fi
    prev="$3"
    cmd=""
    opts=""

    for i in "${COMP_WORDS[@]:0:COMP_CWORD}"
    do
        case "${cmd},${i}" in
            ",$1")
                cmd="spt"
                ;;
            spt,about)

#compdef spt

autoload -U is-at-least

_spt() {
    typeset -A opt_args
    typeset -a _arguments_options
    local ret=1

    if is-at-least 5.2; then
        _arguments_options=(-s -S -C)
    else
        _arguments_options=(-s -C)
    fi

    local context curcontext="$curcontext" state line
    _arguments "${_arguments_options[@]}" : \
'--config=[Path to a single config file]:PATH:_files' \
'--config-dir=[Path to a directory of \`*.toml\` configs (loaded in lexical order)]:PATH:_files' \
'--config-url=[HTTPS URL of a remote config to fetch]:URL:_default' \
'--config-fingerprint=[SHA-256 fingerprint pin for \`--config-url\`]:SHA256:_default' \
'--state-dir=[Override the runtime state directory]:PATH:_files' \
'--profile=[Restrict operations to the named profile]:NAME:_default' \
'--output=[Output format for command results]:OUTPUT:((human\:"Human-readable text (default)"
json\:"Structured JSON"
jsonl\:"JSON Lines (one record per line)"
yaml\:"YAML"))' \
'--log-level=[Tracing log level]:LOG_LEVEL:((error\:"Only errors"
warn\:"Warnings and above"
info\:"Informational and above (default)"
debug\:"Debug and above"
trace\:"Trace and above (very verbose)"))' \
'--color=[Color policy for human output]:COLOR:((auto\:"Auto-detect based on tty"
always\:"Always emit color escapes"
never\:"Never emit color escapes"))' \
'--portable[Portable mode\: keep all runtime state next to the executable instead of OS-standard locations (no OS install required)]' \
'--json[Convenience alias for \`--output json\`]' \
'-q[Suppress non-essential output]' \
'--quiet[Suppress non-essential output]' \
'*-v[Increase verbosity (repeat for more)]' \
'*--verbose[Increase verbosity (repeat for more)]' \
'--no-color[Disable color (legacy convenience flag; use \`--color never\`)]' \
'--dry-run[Show what would happen without making changes]' \
'-h[Print help (see more with '\''--help'\'')]' \
'--help[Print help (see more with '\''--help'\'')]' \
'-V[Print version]' \
'--version[Print version]' \
":: :_spt_commands" \
"*::: :->spt" \
&& ret=0
    case $state in
    (spt)
        words=($line[1] "${words[@]}")
        (( CURRENT += 1 ))
        curcontext="${curcontext%:*:*}:spt-command-$line[1]:"
        case $line[1] in
            (config)
_arguments "${_arguments_options[@]}" : \

(help)
_arguments "${_arguments_options[@]}" : \
":: :_spt__subcmd__forward__subcmd__help_commands" \
"*::: :->help" \
&& ret=0

    case $state in
    (help)
        words=($line[1] "${words[@]}")
        (( CURRENT += 1 ))
        curcontext="${curcontext%:*:*}:spt-forward-help-command-$line[1]:"
        case $line[1] in
            (list)
_arguments "${_arguments_options[@]}" : \
&& ret=0
;;
(show)
_arguments "${_arguments_options[@]}" : \
&& ret=0
;;
(add)
_arguments "${_arguments_options[@]}" : \
":: :_spt__subcmd__forward__subcmd__help__subcmd__add_commands" \
"*::: :->add" \
&& ret=0

    case $state in
    (add)
        words=($line[1] "${words[@]}")
        (( CURRENT += 1 ))
        curcontext="${curcontext%:*:*}:spt-forward-help-add-command-$line[1]:"
        case $line[1] in
            (local)
_arguments "${_arguments_options[@]}" : \
&& ret=0
;;
(remote)
_arguments "${_arguments_options[@]}" : \
&& ret=0
;;
(dynamic)
_arguments "${_arguments_options[@]}" : \
&& ret=0
;;
        esac
    ;;
esac

(( $+functions[_spt_commands] )) ||
_spt_commands() {
    local commands; commands=(
'config:Manage configuration files (init, validate, diff, render, reload)' \
'profile:Manage SSH/SSH3 tunnel profiles' \
'forward:Manage forwards (local/remote TCP, UDP)' \
'tunnel:Run, inspect, and control tunnels' \
'service:Install and control native services' \
'key:Generate, inspect, and install SSH keys' \
'secret:Manage the secret vault and OS keychain references' \
'auth:Authentication helpers' \
'dns:Built-in DNS resolver and hosts-file management' \
'firewall:Inspect and manage OS firewall / packet-filter rules' \
'log:Log tailing, sink testing, and export' \
'observe:Metrics and Windows Event Log helpers' \
'event:Event bindings and sinks' \
'stats:Statistics summaries and live counters' \
'session:Inspect and manage active sessions' \
'ftp:FTP→SFTP translator service' \
'sftp:SFTP file operations and mount planning' \
'diagnose:Targeted diagnostics and support bundles' \
'benchmark:Controlled benchmarking against forwards' \
'mcp:Built-in MCP server controls' \
'ssh3-serve:Run the in-repo SSH3 (QUIC + HTTP/3) server end — the responder half of an spt↔spt SSH3 tunnel' \
'status:Show overall app status — daemon, tunnels/profiles, forwards, and subsystems (status API, MCP, DNS, metrics, remote-config, events, services)' \
'status-api:Controls for the read-only HTTP status API' \
'completion:Generate shell completions' \
'about:List bundled libraries and their licenses' \
'kill:Terminate every running \`spt\` instance on this host' \
'update:Embedded auto-updater (off by default). Manual commands work regardless of the \`\[updater\].enabled\` flag; the background polling thread is only spawned when explicitly enabled' \
'help:Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)' \
    )
    _describe -t commands 'spt commands' commands "$@"
}

'gen-key:Generate a config-encryption key (X25519 keypair or raw PSK)' \
'help:Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)' \
    )

(( $+functions[_spt__subcmd__sftp_commands] )) ||
_spt__subcmd__sftp_commands() {
    local commands; commands=(
'test:Connect to the profile and open the SFTP subsystem' \
'list:List a remote directory' \
'stat:Show metadata for a remote path' \
'get:Download a remote file' \
'put:Upload a local file' \
'mkdir:Create a remote directory' \
'rm:Remove a remote file' \
'rmdir:Remove a remote directory' \
'rename:Rename a remote file or directory' \
'cat:Print a remote file (with a size cap)' \
'tail:Print the trailing bytes of a remote file' \
'chmod:Change POSIX permissions on a remote path' \
'symlink:Create a remote symbolic link' \
'readlink:Read the target of a remote symbolic link' \
'realpath:Canonicalise a remote path' \
'put-recursive:Mirror a local directory tree onto the server (recursive \`put\`)' \
'get-recursive:Mirror a remote directory tree onto the local filesystem (recursive \`get\`)' \
'mount:Manage SFTP-backed filesystem mount entries' \
'drive:Manage SFTP-backed Windows drive entries' \
'umount:Tear down an SFTP-backed filesystem mount (shorthand for \`spt sftp mount stop\`)' \
'help:Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)' \
    )
    _describe -t commands 'spt sftp commands' commands "$@"
}
